question.text: The MINIMUM initial investment required from a PMS client (non-accredited) is:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Effective 2020 onwards: Rs. 50 lakh minimum investment for PMS clients (up from earlier Rs. 25 lakh). Accredited Investors have separate provisions. **The Trap:** Rs. 25 lakh was pre-2020 threshold; Rs. 1 crore / Rs. 2 crore are AIF territory. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-A, XIX-A/B all touch. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Accredited investor (AI) regime enables relaxation — AI clients can invest in customised strategies even below Rs. 50 lakh in some cases.
